Nelson Hysa challenges Agit Kabayel for the WBC title on Saturday in Dusseldorf; Hard-punching Hysa hopes to upset popular German Kabayel and then look to take on his 'favourite fighter' Tyson Fury; Hysa says Moses Itauma is still the best in the division - 'I don't want to fight him!'
Sports Journalist @johndennen
Tuesday 24 November 2026 19:23, UK
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Nelson Hysa has a vision. He wants to dethrone Agit Kabayel, win the WBC heavyweight world title and then take on his favourite fighter – Tyson Fury.
Hysa, unbeaten in 25 professional fights, challenges Kabayel on Saturday for the WBC heavyweight world championship.
The Albanian has taken 23 of those wins inside the distance and is looking to upset the popular German when they fight in Dusseldorf this weekend.
A power-puncher, Hysa told Sky Sports : "The knockout was with me from the first day that I started boxing.
"In this match [against Kabayel] I am preparing to do more good rounds because I know the opponent is a very good boxer, he's a tough boxer, a serious boxer.
"But we are planning, we are trying to do our best. We have our strategy to win the match and I think we will win the match earlier than the 12th round.
"I need to move up the ratio of knockouts!"
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
With Oleksandr Usyk vacating his championships, there are now new belt-holders in the division, but Hysa does not consider Kabayel the best of the current heavyweight titlists.
"For me No 1 now of the guys that have the belts, No 1 is Filip Hrgovic, [then Daniel] Dubois and for me the special one is Tyson Fury.

"Hrgovic will do very good because he's a good boxer," Hysa added. "Hrgovic beat the best guy in the heavyweight division. He beat Moses [Itauma]. I don't want to do a fight with Moses, he's a good guy! He will be the best heavyweight in the world. He is the best heavyweight in the world but he needs more time."
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Fury will fight Anthony Joshua for the WBA 'super' heavyweight title when they meet on December 11. Hysa tips Fury to win and is eager to box him in a unification if he comes through his own fight.
"Who doesn't want to fight Tyson Fury? He's a legend," Hysa said. "The No 1 man at heavyweight.
"He's my No 1 favourite boxer, I love him, I love everything he does. His style, everything.
"Who doesn't want to fight Tyson Fury?"

Nelson Xisa koʻrish qobiliyatiga ega. U Agit Kabayelni taxtdan tushirishni, WBC yoʻnalishi boʻyicha jahon chempionligini qoʻlga kiritishni va keyin oʻzining sevimli jangchisi - Tayson Fyuriga qarshi tura olishni istaydi.
Professional boʻyicha 25 ta jangda magʻlub boʻlmagan Xysa shanba kuni WBC yoʻnalishi boʻyicha jahon chempionligi uchun Kabayel bilan kurash olib boradi.
Albaniyalik ushbu gʻalabalarning 23 tasini masofada qoʻlga kiritdi va shu hafta oxirida Dyusseldorfdagi jangda mashhur nemisni xafa qilmoqchi.
Kuchli zarba beruvchi Xaysa Sky Sports nashriga shunday dedi: "Boksni boshlaganimning birinchi kunidanoq nokaut men bilan boʻlgan.
“Ushbu uchrashuvda [Kabayelga qarshi] koʻproq yaxshi raundlar oʻtkazishga tayyorlanyapman, chunki raqib juda yaxshi bokschi, u qattiq bokschi, jiddiy bokschi ekanligini bilaman.

"Ammo biz rejalashtirmoqdamiz, qoʻlimizdan kelganini qilishga harakat qilyapmiz. Uchrashuvda gʻalaba qozonish uchun oʻz strategiyamiz bor va oʻylaymanki, 12-turdan ham ertaroq oʻyinda gʻalaba qozonamiz.
"Men nokautlar nisbatini oshirishim kerak!"
Iltimos, qulayroq video pleer uchun Chrome brauzeridan foydalaning
Oleksandr Usik chempionligini tark etar ekan, endi divizionda yangi kamar sohiblari paydo boʻldi, biroq Xysa Kabayelni hozirgi ogʻir vazn toifasidagi eng yaxshisi deb hisoblamaydi.
“Men uchun kamar egalari orasida 1-oʻrin, Filip Xrgovich, Daniel Dyubua, men uchun esa Tayson Fyuri.

"Hrgovich juda yaxshi ishlaydi, chunki u yaxshi bokschi", - deya qoʻshimcha qildi Xysa. "Hrgovich ogʻir vazn toifasida eng yaxshi yigitni magʻlub etdi. U Musoni [Itauma] ni magʻlub etdi. Men Muso bilan jang qilishni xohlamayman, u yaxshi yigit! U dunyodagi eng yaxshi ogʻir vaznli boʻladi. U dunyodagi eng yaxshi ogʻir vaznli, lekin unga koʻproq vaqt kerak ".
Iltimos, qulayroq video pleer uchun Chrome brauzeridan foydalaning

Fyuri 11 dekabr kuni boʻlib oʻtadigan WBA "super ogʻir vazn toifasi" chempioni Entoni Joshua bilan jang qiladi. Xisa Fyuriga gʻalaba qozonishini maslahat beradi va agar u oʻz jangi orqali chiqsa, uni birlashmada boks qilishni xohlaydi.
"Kim Tayson Fyuri bilan jang qilishni istamaydi? U afsona", - deydi Xysa. "Ogʻir vazndagi 1-raqamli odam.
“U mening 1-raqamli sevimli bokschim, men uni yaxshi koʻraman, men uning qilgan barcha ishlarini yaxshi koʻraman. Uning uslubi, hamma narsa.
"Kim Tayson Fyuri bilan jang qilishni xohlamaydi?"

body: “Real Madrid” bosh murabbiyi Joze Mourinyo Chempionlar Ligasidan oʻrin olgan “PSV Eyndxoven” jamoasiga qarshi oʻyindan keyin Jud Bellingemni maqtadi.

Uchrashuv 5:1 hisobida madridliklar gʻalabasi bilan yakunlandi. Bellingem birinchi boʻlimdan keyin zaxiradan maydonga tushdi va hisob 1:1 boʻlib turgan paytda 60-daqiqada uzoqdan zarba yoʻllab, gol kiritishga muvaffaq boʻldi.
“U juda ajoyib oʻyin koʻrsatdi. Fantastik gol kiritib, oʻyinni oʻzgartirib yubordi.
Ba’zi futbolchilar oʻyinlardan keyin charchoq his qilishadi. Men Bellingemsiz ham gʻalaba qozonishimiz mumkin, deb oʻylagandim, lekin adashibman. Uni iloji boricha ehtiyot qilishga harakat qilgandim.
Menda ajoyib zaxira futbolchilari bor. Bu juda muhim omil”, dedi Mourinyo.

items.title: Rangers 'dug it out' despite naivety & complacency - McInnes
items.summary: Rangers manager Derek McInnes says his team's naivety and complacency made their task more difficult in their thrilling 3-2 win over Aberdeen, but hails their ability to get the job done.
body: Image source, SNS
Rangers scored three goals in 11 minutes at the start of the second half after a triple substitution
ByJack Herrall
BBC Sport Scotland
Watch Rangers v Aberdeen highlights
Rangers manager Derek McInnes says his team's naivety and complacency made their task more difficult in their thrilling 3-2 win over Aberdeen, but hailed their ability to get the job done.

The Ibrox outfit had to navigate a tense finale as they held off a defiant Aberdeen side, just three days after their dramatic late win at Motherwell, and are now just a point behind Celtic at the Scottish Premiership summit.
Rangers had roared into a 3-1 lead after a stunning 11-minute burst at the start of the second half overwhelmed the visitors, who led at the break through Brad Lyons' header.
However, the Dons pulled one back through vibrant youngster Findlay Marshall and both sides had opportunities to add to the scoreline in a gripping closing passage.
"We put ourselves in the mire there, we were so naive at times," McInnes told Sky Sports.
"The biggest part for me is how we lose the initiative by just being too complacent and that has to change because we won't always outscore opponents.

"Once we got ourselves in front you think 'just keep the shoulder to the wheel'. We hit them like a train and they were 3-1 down because of the speed, intensity, intelligence and then we started to play backwards.
"We played more backwards passes than I can remember in a long time, we need to show more control."
McInnes' displeasure at the first-half display manifested itself in a half-time triple substitution as Findlay Curtis, Tuur Rommens and Kim Min-Su were hurled into the action.
Rangers were a different team in the 11 minutes that followed, with goals from Ryan Naderi, Djeidi Gassama and Nico Raskin turning the game on its head and flipping the mood of the Ibrox faithful.
"For us it was all about winning, we've won the game and we'll dust ourselves down," McInnes added after a 14th straight game without defeat.
"It was three good goals and I'm delighted by the impact of the subs and we dug it out, but we made it harder for ourselves."
That ability to grind out wins was evident at Fir Park on Saturday and was apparent again at Ibrox. Belief is growing among Rangers supporters, who are longing for a first league title in six years.
They have won six points from losing positions this season, a tally bettered only by St Johnstone and Celtic, who have seven apiece.
A win over Falkirk on Saturday, before Celtic travel to face Hearts on Sunday, would put Rangers top of the table for just the second time this season.
'Where would Rangers be without Naderi?'
Rangers' dramatic 64-second turnaround
For the umpteenth time this season, Rangers were indebted to in-form striker Naderi.
The 23-year-old struggled for a consistent run of games in the early stages of his Ibrox career, but has more shown his worth with Youssef Chermiti and Lawrence Shankland sidelined through injury.

He has 13 goal contributions in 13 league appearances - eight goals and five assists - and also fired Rangers into the Premier Sports Cup final with his winner against Aberdeen at Hampden earlier this month.
"A lot of players have had plaudits recently, but where would Rangers be without Naderi?," former Rangers striker Kris Boyd asked on Sky Sports.
"He's scored big goals for Rangers this season. His goal return has been outstanding and they're big, big goals for Rangers."
Naderi, who featured twice for the Czech Republic during the international break, has the Scottish Premiership's highest expected goals (xG) and xG per 90 minutes.
His perfectly weighted assist for Gassama showed the touch of a player full of confidence and playing at the peak of his powers.
Did Dons deserve more?
Image source, SNS
After weathering an early Rangers storm, Aberdeen took the lead and looked well worth their advantage at half-time.

For all of their endeavour and late surge, they failed to recover from their 11-minute capitulation. Still, Aberdeen legend Willie Miller was heartened by the performance under new head coach Mario Frick.
"It's been a long time since I've seen a performance as good as that from an Aberdeen side, albeit it was a defeat," Miller said.
"They pushed Rangers all the way. It will be a learning process for them, you'd certainly hope that would be the case."
15-year-old Andrew Fasanya's introduction shows Frick has no issues playing young players who merit game time, and 20-year-old Marshall was perhaps the standout performer of the night.
"When Aberdeen got their second, they gave as good as they got," McCall added.
"It's the type of game, and Aberdeen will be gutted to have lost it, but you can see progress, an idea, a bond with the supporters.
"A young Scottish player [Marshall], I thought was the best player on the park, too."

uz.title: Reynjers soddalik va xotirjamlikka qaramay, uni "qazib olishdi" - McInnes
uz.summary: "Reynjers" menejeri Derek Makinnesning aytishicha, uning jamoasining soddaligi va xotirjamligi Aberdin ustidan 3:2 hisobidagi hayajonli gʻalabada ularning vazifalarini qiyinlashtirgan, ammo ularning ishni uddalash qobiliyatini olqishlaydi.
body: Rasm manbai, SNS
Reynjers ikkinchi boʻlim boshida uch marta almashtirilgandan soʻng 11 daqiqa ichida uchta gol urishdi
Muallif: Jek Xerral
BBC Sport Shotland
"Reynjers" - "Aberdin" uchrashuvining asosiy lahzalarini tomosha qiling

"Reynjers" menejeri Derek Makinnesning aytishicha, uning jamoasining soddaligi va xotirjamligi Aberdin ustidan 3:2 hisobidagi hayajonli gʻalabada ularning vazifasini qiyinlashtirgan, ammo ularning ishni uddalash qobiliyatini olqishlagan.

Motherwellda kechgan dramatik gʻalabadan atigi uch kun oʻtib, Shotlandiya Premer-ligasi sammitida "Seltik"dan atigi bir ochko ortda qolib ketgan Ibrox libosi shiddatli finalni bosib oʻtishga majbur boʻldi.

Ikkinchi boʻlim boshida 11 daqiqalik ajoyib zarba mehmonlarni magʻlub etganidan soʻng "Reynjers" 3:1 hisobida oldinga chiqib oldi, ular tanaffusda Bred Lionsning boshi bilan darvozani ishgʻol qilishdi.
Biroq, Dons jonli yosh oʻyinchi Findlay Marshall orqali raqibni qaytarib oldi va ikkala tomon ham yakuniy oʻtishda hisobni qoʻshish imkoniyatiga ega boʻldi.
"Biz oʻzimizni u erda botqoqqa tashladik, ba'zida juda sodda edik", dedi MakInnes Sky Sportsga.
"Men uchun eng muhimi shundaki, biz oʻta xotirjamlik tufayli tashabbusni yoʻqotamiz va bu oʻzgarishi kerak, chunki biz har doim ham raqiblardan ustun kela olmaymiz.

"Biz oldinga chiqqanimizdan soʻng, siz "gʻildirakni yelkada ushlab turing" deb oʻylaysiz. Biz ularni poyezdga oʻxshatib urdik va ular tezlik, shiddatlilik, aql-zakovat tufayli 3:1 hisobida ortda qoldi va keyin biz orqaga oʻynay boshladik.
"Biz uzoq vaqtdan beri eslab qolganimdan koʻra koʻproq orqaga toʻp uzatmalarini oʻynadik, biz koʻproq nazorat koʻrsatishimiz kerak."
Makinnesning birinchi boʻlimdagi namoyishidan noroziligi oʻzini yarim taymda uch marta almashtirishda namoyon boʻldi, chunki Findlay Curtis, Tuur Rommens va Kim Min-Su maydonga tushishdi.
Keyingi 11 daqiqada “Reynjers” ​​boshqacha jamoa boʻldi, Rayan Naderi, Djeidi Gassama va Niko Raskinning gollari oʻyinni oʻzgartirib yubordi va Ibrox sodiqlarining kayfiyatini koʻtardi.
"Biz uchun gʻalaba qozonish haqida edi, biz oʻyinda gʻalaba qozondik va biz oʻzimizni changlatamiz", deb qoʻshib qoʻydi Makinnes ketma-ket 14-magʻlubiyatsiz oʻyindan keyin.
"Bu uchta yaxshi gol boʻldi va men subsning ta'siridan xursandman va biz uni qazib oldik, lekin biz buni oʻzimizga qiyinlashtirdik."

Gʻalaba qozonish qobiliyati shanba kuni Fir Parkda yaqqol namoyon boʻldi va Ibroxda yana yaqqol namoyon boʻldi. Olti yil ichida birinchi liga chempionligini qoʻlga kiritmoqchi boʻlgan "Reynjers" tarafdorlari orasida ishonch kuchayib bormoqda.
Ular bu mavsumdagi yoʻqotishlardan olti ochkoga ega boʻlishdi, bu koʻrsatkichdan faqat Sent-Jonston va Seltikdan koʻra koʻproq, ularda yettitadan.
Shanba kuni Falkirk ustidan qozonilgan gʻalaba, yakshanba kuni "Seltik" "Hearts"ga qarshi oʻyin oldidan, "Reynjers" bu mavsumda ikkinchi marta turnir jadvalida birinchi oʻrinni egallaydi.
— Naderisiz Reynjers qayerda edi?
Reynjersning 64 soniyalik dramatik burilishlari
"Reynjers" bu mavsumda oʻn marotaba forvard hujumchisi Naderidan qarzdor boʻlib qoldi.
23 yoshli futbolchi Ibrox faoliyatining dastlabki bosqichlarida barqaror oʻyinlar uchun kurashdi, ammo Youssef Chermiti va Lourens Shenklend jarohati tufayli oʻzini koʻproq koʻrsatdi.

U ligada 13 ta oʻyinda 13 ta gol urdi - 8 ta gol va 5 ta golli uzatma, shuningdek, shu oy boshida Xempdenda Aberdinga qarshi oʻyinda gʻolib boʻlgan Reynjersni Premer Sport Kubogi finaliga olib chiqdi.
"Soʻnggi paytlarda koʻplab oʻyinchilar maqtovga sazovor boʻlishdi, ammo Naderisiz "Reynjers" qayerda boʻlardi?", - deb soʻradi "Reynjers"ning sobiq hujumchisi Kris Boyd Sky Sports telekanalida.
"U bu mavsumda "Reynjers" uchun katta gollar urdi. Uning gollarini qaytarish ajoyib boʻldi va ular "Reynjers" uchun katta, katta gol."
Xalqaro tanaffusda Chexiya terma jamoasi safida ikki marta maydonga tushgan Naderi Shotlandiya Premer-ligasida 90 daqiqada urilgan eng yuqori kutilgan gol (xG) va xGga ega.
Uning Gassamaga bergan ajoyib uzatmasi oʻz kuchining choʻqqisida oʻynagan va oʻziga ishongan oʻyinchining teginishini koʻrsatdi.
Dons koʻproq narsaga loyiq edimi?
Rasm manbai, SNS
"Reynjers"ning erta boʻroniga bardosh berganidan soʻng, Aberdin oldinga chiqdi va tanaffusda oʻz ustunligiga arziydi.

Barcha urinishlari va kechikishlari uchun ular 11 daqiqalik taslim boʻlishdan oʻzlarini tiklay olmadilar. Shunday boʻlsa-da, "Aberdin" afsonasi Villi Miller yangi bosh murabbiy Mario Frik qoʻl ostidagi oʻyindan xursand boʻldi.
"Men Aberdin jamoasining magʻlubiyatga uchraganiga qaramay, shunchalik yaxshi oʻyin koʻrmaganimga ancha vaqt boʻldi", dedi Miller.
"Ular Reynjersni oxirigacha itarib yuborishdi. Bu ular uchun oʻquv jarayoni boʻladi, siz albatta shunday boʻlishiga umid qilasiz."

15 yoshli Endryu Fasanyaning muqaddimasi shuni koʻrsatadiki, Frik oʻyin vaqtiga munosib boʻlgan yosh oʻyinchilarni oʻynashda hech qanday muammo yoʻq va 20 yoshli Marshall, ehtimol, kechaning ajoyib ijrochisi boʻlgan.
"Aberdin ikkinchi oʻrinni egallaganida, ular qoʻllaridan kelgancha yaxshilik qilishdi", deya qoʻshimcha qildi MakKall.
"Bu oʻyin turi va Aberdin uni yoʻqotib qoʻygani uchun gʻazablanadi, ammo siz taraqqiyotni, gʻoyani, tarafdorlar bilan aloqani koʻrishingiz mumkin.
"Yosh shotlandiyalik futbolchi [Marshall], men ham parkdagi eng yaxshi oʻyinchi deb oʻylardim."
